posts.text:
Pretty excited for tomorrow's SKH

Hope you like oil company shareholder drama

My "helicopter tally" so far today has reached double digits. I've started checking flight trackers and its almost always a military craft seemingly just doing fucking laps around several local, otherwise quiet neighborhoods.

Predominantly minority neighborhoods, specifically.
Wishing every member of the military who has been participating in the massive spike in low flying helicopter patrols over residential neighborhoods for more than a year now a very crash

Posted a studio tour over on my Patreon yesterday if you wanna see me do show-and-tell for a bit

www.patreon.com/posts/studio...

begging

pleading

for people to migrate off of substack

not on my knees tho, im just sitting at my computer typing this

tsp = teaspoon

tbsp = teablespoon

The US: *assassinates the head of state of Iran*

Also the US: "It's not our fault this is still going on! Their leadership is a mess!"
I've got a smattering of songs from the Chicago soundtrack stuck in my head this morning and somehow none of them are the Cell Block Tango
Cannot think of a bigger group of sniveling cowards than the current gaggle of jabronies calling themselves an administration

New episode of my Satisfactory series is up on my FUNDEAVORANCE channel!

Come watch as I slowly lose my mind while a Tactical Lawn Service does everything it can to sabotage my recording

Here's the thing: www.youtube.com/watch?v=0wjP...
Followed by several minutes of “what’s up guys” and “without further ado” before a stock after effects intro logo

“I almost RETURNED Tech Device XYZ”

“BEFORE YOU BUY Tech Device XYZ, You Should Know THIS”

Me: "Hm, I feel like I could benefit from buying Tech Device XYZ. Maybe I’ll look up reviews on YouTube to see more info"

Every review title: "I was DISAPPOINTED by Tech Device XYZ… Or Was I??"

We should try something new, like giving tax breaks to the oldest generation who already holds the majority of the nations wealth, and maybe double or triple a few police budgets.

If all else fails, we could always try manufacturing a crisis demanding military intervention 🤔
aight yeah no this is the actual correct answer
auto-folding clothes was probably my pick as well. I cannot stand the act of folding laundry

Alright you get one magic spell which you can cast at will. It can only do one basic, hyper specific task that you could otherwise do, but it does it perfectly and instantly 

What's your spell do?
I get that they’re playing it up for political points but hot damn; if “guy got kinda near a place with a gun” is enough to spark them to demand a ballroom…

The major outlets have all made these big infographic filled pieces about the "Timeline of the shooting at the White House Correspondents Dinner" as if it was some huge deal

This country has hundreds of millions of people and even more guns, and the guy didn't even make it near the ballroom
Good morning. Please be sure to put the dishes into the proper receptacle on your way out.
